name: Metadata only, no light curve (a floor)

provenance.method: Never reads a light curve. A logistic regression on the public TOI number, period, duration, ephemeris errors and epoch, fitted on the tuning half's CP/KP against FP TOIs; held-out stars above the threshold (0.464, chosen by 5-fold cross-validated J = 0.41 on the tuning half) get one event on the published ephemeris. The same events stand on the controls, because the method ignores the light curve. A floor, not a vetter.
